sessionName: Week 1 - Target deal profile and positioning
summary: First session with Helen and Mark to define the deals Calder Bridge should be chasing and how the firm stands apart from national mid-market funds. We agreed a tighter target deal profile around £1.5m to £5m EBITDA in the North and three priority sectors. Positioning will lead with the in-house operating team. The question of walking away from high headline multiples is still open.

discussion.keyPoints: Helen said 6 of the last 8 completed deals came through corporate finance advisers in Leeds and Manchester. Very little is proprietary. Mark worried the £10m EV floor pulls in too many lifestyle businesses with no second tier of management.
Calder mostly meets national mid-market funds and regional debt funds. Helen estimated they lose on headline price in roughly two of every five processes they reach second round in.
Helen wants whatever we build for origination to double as a commercial playbook the portfolio companies can reuse. Mark asked that we keep the fund's own deal flow as the priority.

recommendations.recommendation: Define the target as founder or family-owned businesses in Yorkshire, the North East and the North West with £1.5m to £5m EBITDA and a second-tier management team ready to step up.
Prioritise three sectors: industrial services, B2B software and specialist distribution. Deprioritise consumer retail and hospitality.
Position Calder as the operator-led Northern buy-out partner, leading with the four operating partners rather than the size of the fund.
Stop chasing headline multiples above 7x EBITDA and compete instead on certainty, backed by a 10-week completion commitment from heads of terms.
Build a separate tracker of the 12 funds Calder meets most often in Northern processes.

actions.action: Pull source, sector and outcome data for the last 20 deals reviewed at IC
Draft one-page sector notes for the three priority sectors

nextFocus: Turn the operator-led positioning into a value proposition for founders and a separate message for corporate finance advisers.
nextPreparation: Bring two recent founder pitch decks and any feedback from advisers on lost processes.
